answer.answer: Audit-ready reconciliation completed and persisted as checkpoint checkpoint:485260f4-614a-4e92-6ffb-0a1a2951d3ef. The archive remains losslessly retained as provenance, its executable-version claim is corrected, unique player-derived material was selectively promoted, duplicate game data did not become a second canonical snapshot, and rejected Flowworks work remains audit-only.

claims.value: The completed import preserves Star Rupture Game Analysis.zip losslessly: 21,674,717 bytes, SHA-256 1a1c1ef0ae00905ced37f1221ab22c4b9268f2ebe17b7516e6c9cac67d7f6fa3, 123 archive entries including directories, and 115 manifested files plus CHECKSUMS.sha256. unzip -t and every packaged SHA-256 passed. The original ZIP and verified extracted tree remain under raw/, which is Git-ignored because it includes a duplicate third-party corpus, personalized save context, generated binaries, and a legacy SQLite database; tracked MANIFEST.csv and CHECKSUMS.sha256 retain the audit trail. The import ID is star-rupture-game-analysis__20260708T190137Z, archive retrieval time is 2026-07-08T19:01:37Z, and import completion time is 2026-07-11T19:54:52Z.

The archive's repeated build 23761620 description is corrected to a two-axis boundary. Its source/game-data claim is Update 1, internal version 35118973, dated 2026-04-09 and contextually mapped to Steam build 22674441; the canonical source capture is SRDB 2.3.4, captured 2026-07-11, with snapshot ID ea-u1-gv35118973__srdb-2.3.4__20260711T050230Z. Hotfix 0.2.8, Steam build 23761620, is only the latest public executable observed at capture and is not proven provenance for every numeric source value. Imported numeric reports remain legacy calculations until rerun against that canonical snapshot.

No second canonical game-data snapshot was created. The archive's 468 items, 191 public buildings, 234 recipe definitions, 77 Corporation levels, 121 export offers, 15 upgrades, 3,259 map markers, 3,094 loot rows, and official-news subset were semantically duplicated by the richer RuptureOps corpus and were retained only as legacy provenance. Selective promotion was limited to models/rourke-update1-save-baseline__20260711.json; six imported Ore Excavator v2 recipe/producer associations in sources/recipe-producer-overrides.json; explicit consumable-effect assumptions in sources/consumable-effects.json; nine player-specific site/geography assets; and consolidated player-save, architecture, geography, progression, exploration, food, and remote-resource notes. Reconciliation also corrected two normalization defects: airlock had been overwritten by a building-shaped detail response, and Training Corporation retained a literal $undefined index.

The complete 18-file Flowworks Campaign Sizing - Levels 8 to 15 family is superseded audit history, not current authority. Its buffer-heavy model, five-output-depot bank, and overbuilt three-Stabilizer/two-slow-press direction must not be reactivated without new evidence. The July 11 canonical guidance is explicitly a plan, not confirmed construction: begin with one Stabilizer, one Impeller, and one Turbine; add one Nozzle and two Valves in the valve expansion; add two Pumps for the Pressure Tank stage; add the second Stabilizer before Scanner/levels 11–12; reserve one HRS v2 pad and build it only if imported-HRS recovery fails in practice. The active RuptureOps pipeline, database, progression note, and operating-model note remain authoritative; the archive SQLite database, source snapshot JSON, delivery CSVs, workbook, refresh script, query script, and superseded calculations remain preserved under raw/ for audit only.

claims.value: Grand Basin Reserve is the broad basin immediately east of GRO “Mythic Cry” and north of the active production corridor; the earlier provisional Red Lake/Redleaf match was wrong and is superseded. Mythic Cry lies in the mountains immediately west of the basin. The Grand Basin marker represents the basin area, not a future Core, and the first active campus should remain east of the mountain/POI boundary with a combat exclusion strip.

Flowworks is the selected Ti/W mechanical site between Landerworks and Faraday: east/northeast of Landerworks and west/northwest of Faraday. Faraday is east/southeast of Flowworks and immediately north of CRRO “Warm Dawn.” Flowworks remains a proposed footprint, not a confirmed placed Core; together these sites form the active/proposed production corridor south of Grand Basin.

The overview map’s site pins were registered visually against terrain and express relational placement, not surveyed rail geometry or verified coordinates. Flowworks is a proposed relational footprint, and Grand Basin is an area marker rather than a Core pin. Coordinates in planning notes identify SRDB markers. Screenshot registration and SRDB coordinates must remain separate because no verified transform between those frames exists; therefore exact pins must not be inferred by combining them.

The preferred first Goethite site is the safer northwestern triple at approximately `1393–1464,1838–1891`, northwest of Mythic Cry/Grand Basin. After Engine access and Selenian 9, the adopted plan is three Laser Drills merged into one Goethite-only Cargo link, delivering 45 raw Ore/min into one 1,600-unit Storage Depot v2; the closer west field around `1252–1472,2950–3282` overlaps scanner/hostile envelopes and is not preferred. The preferred first Oil source is approximately `1234,3760`, west/southwest of Mythic Cry and Grand Basin. After Future Health 11, use one Oil Extractor and one Crude-only Cargo link to deliver 10 Crude/min into one V2 buffer feeding one GB-A Refinery. Reserve but do not initially build the second Oil pair and Refinery: one Refinery already consumes the full 10 Crude/min source plus large Titanium and Calcium feeds, while the second marker around `1351,4473` is a separate site. Raw Goethite and Crude Oil are compact but expand during processing, so transport each raw resource through its own item-specific Cargo link and process beside Grand Basin consumers; they may share a receiver yard but not a Cargo link, rail lane, or storage unit.

answer.answer: Resume the July 11 canonical staged Flowworks build. Start with 10 machines, then expand by campaign stage. After the second Stabilizer, imports peak at 252/min, so one 480/min Rail v3 trunk has 228/min headroom before buffer smoothing. Keep bulk Titanium Rod and Wolfram Plate production local. Buffers should smooth refill waves and support real capacity—not replace it—and the reserved HRS v2 pad should be built only if imported-HRS recovery measurably fails.

claims.value: The canonical starter is a planned 10-machine build: 1 Titanium Excavator, 1 Wolfram Excavator, 1 Titanium Smelter, 1 Wolfram Smelter, 1 Titanium Rod v2, 1 Wolfram Powder v2, 1 Wolfram Plate v2, 1 Stabilizer, 1 Impeller, and 1 Turbine. This is the adopted plan, not confirmed construction.

Several forks inherited the exact same `Star Rupture Game Analysis.zip` request; they are duplicate execution paths, not independent imports or corroboration.

Replay identity is `import_id` `star-rupture-game-analysis__20260708T190137Z` plus source archive `Star Rupture Game Analysis.zip` SHA-256 `1a1c1ef0ae00905ced37f1221ab22c4b9268f2ebe17b7516e6c9cac67d7f6fa3`. A fork matching this identity must reuse the immutable source copies and existing reconciliation receipts, not create another import or promotion.

The one successful reconciliation is canonical. The external package is audit history, not a competing source snapshot: its duplicated item, building, recipe, progression, export, map, loot, and news data were not installed again; only distinct evidence was promoted. The active pipeline and canonical snapshot `ea-u1-gv35118973__srdb-2.3.4__20260711T050230Z` remain authoritative, while legacy calculations retain their July 8 boundary until ported and rerun. Dirty-tree safety means making no duplicate promotion or unrelated repository mutation: raw archive content stays under the Git-ignored `raw/` directory, while tracked `MANIFEST.csv` and `CHECKSUMS.sha256` retain auditability. This service-only run did not inspect live Git status and made no repository changes, so any existing dirty work remains untouched.

Exactly one continuation checkpoint was committed: `checkpoint:fc71b98f-a95f-60db-f018-261439399025` at `.straylight/checkpoints/fc71b98f-a95f-60db-f018-261439399025.md`. Future work must first verify the live branch and dirty-file inventory, preserve unrelated changes, and proceed only for a genuinely unresolved facet or a new archive hash.
